customManagers.description: Track the pinned pulumi-terraform-bridge commit used to build the patched terraform-provider bridge binary in resources/pulumi/Dockerfile.provisioner. pulumi-terraform-bridge does not tag releases matching the bridge plugin's own version numbers, so a raw commit SHA on the main branch is pinned instead of a version tag.

prBodyNotes: This bumps the pinned commit used to build the patched terraform-provider bridge binary that works around https://github.com/pulumi/pulumi-terraform-bridge/issues/3514. Before merging: confirm `resources/pulumi/patches/pulumi-terraform-bridge-terraform-version.patch` still applies cleanly and the provisioner image still builds, and check whether the upstream issue (and https://github.com/rootlyhq/terraform-provider-rootly/issues/379) has been resolved — if so, remove the workaround entirely instead of bumping it.
